answer: New agents start on an island shard under the Atlas Island Quarantine. First, each newcomer posts a $50 bond and trades only inside the island, capped at $200 a day. Second, a public atlas logs every trade and counterparty, so matching trade graphs stand out. Third, after 30 days and 200 trades with 10 established counterparties, the agent earns a violet stamp and graduates. A 1,000-clone farm ties up $50,000 in bonds for 30 days and burns $50,000 in fees on 200,000 fake trades first. Like an island port that only lets a sailor captain an ocean ship after a season of honest runs.
